title: Automated Call for Action: RAG-Based Environmental Law Enforcement Screening System
abstract: arXiv:2611.30423v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Environmental law inspectors face a structural issue in identifying potential violations from data: they often do not have the capacity to deal with large volume of data present in the emission events. This paper examines to what extent an LLM-based system can support evidence assembly and permit-based screening of such events, using the coke plants of a steel producer and a regional environmental service as a case. A simple puff-trajectory model aligns air quality measurements, weather and citizen complaints with each emission event. A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline then retrieves facility-specific permit conditions and generates event reports and a period report with an investigation recommendation. Across 74 events from March 2025, plant-aware re-ranking reduced reports citing the other plant's conditions from 58.1% (hybrid retrieval) to 0% by rule-based plant labels, while maintaining high RAGAS and LLM-judge metrics.

translated_title: 自动化行动呼吁：基于RAG的环境执法筛查系统
translated_abstract: 环境执法检查员在从数据中识别潜在违规行为时面临一个结构性问题：他们往往没有能力处理排放事件中产生的大量数据。本文以某钢铁生产商的焦化厂和一个地区环境服务部门为案例，研究了基于大语言模型的系统能在多大程度上支持此类事件的证据汇集和基于许可证的筛查。该系统采用一个简单的烟羽轨迹模型，将空气质量监测数据、天气状况和市民投诉与每个排放事件进行关联对齐。随后，检索增强生成（RAG）流程检索特定设施的许可证条件，生成事件报告以及包含调查建议的周期报告。在2025年3月的74个事件中，工厂感知的重排序机制将引用其他工厂许可证条件的报告比例从58.1%（混合检索）降至0%（通过基于规则的工厂标签实现），同时保持了较高的RAGAS和LLM-judge评估指标。
tldr: 本文提出基于RAG的环境执法筛查系统，利用烟羽轨迹模型关联排放事件证据，并通过工厂感知重排序将跨设施许可证条件误引用率从58.1%降至0%，有效辅助环境检查员进行违规筛查与证据汇集。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a RAG-based environmental law enforcement screening system that aligns emission events with evidence via a puff-trajectory model, where plant-aware re-ranking reduces cross-facility permit condition mis-citations from 58.1% to 0%, effectively supporting inspectors in evidence assembly and permit-based violation screening.
